jobs.title: Security Officer - All Shifts, No Experience
jobs.description:
Statewide Patrol in Austin is looking for Security Officers to join their team. The position offers full-time roles with shifts available throughout Austin and surrounding areas. Candidates must be 18 years or older, have reliable transportation, a working smartphone, and a clean criminal background.

A retention bonus of $300 is offered for qualifying employees. This is a great opportunity for those looking to start a career in security.
